title: 6-week path to build AI agents
blurb: You don't need 14 courses. Build ugly, learn why it's ugly, fix it. A concrete week-by-week plan.
body:
"You don't need 14 courses to build AI agents. You need 6 weeks and this path."

  • Week 1 · Understand the pattern — Anthropic's "Building Effective Agents" + Chip Huyen's agent explainer. ~3 hours total. No courses yet.
  • Week 2 · Build something ugly — Langflow (no-code, ~1 hour to ship). A research agent, a Slack bot, anything. Now you have context for everything else.
  • Weeks 3–4 · Understand what you built — AI Agents in LangGraph + Agent Memory. Rebuild your ugly thing properly.
  • Weeks 5–6 · Deploy it — LangSmith for tracing, Railway or Render for hosting. Now it's a portfolio piece.

The trap: "I need to understand transformers first." "I'll start when I have more time." Instead: build ugly, learn why it's ugly, fix it.

SOURCE · LinkedIn learning-path post.
